title: Grateful Dead Live at McGaw Memorial Hall, Northwestern U. on 1973-11-01
source: Set 2 Source: Soundboard > Master-Reel > Reel (1st gen) > DAT (44.1k)

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a peak‑performance set with thundering Phil bass and a standout Morning Dew
ai_review.review: All four reviewers rave about the pristine, ultra‑crisp recording quality – calling it the cleanest on the Archive with virtually no distortion, especially on Phil Lesh’s bass. The show itself is described as a superb sequence of tunes that “keeps on giving,” highlighted by an inspired rendition of Morning Dew and an overall peak‑of‑performance vibe.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently 5‑star feedback emphasizing both exceptional soundboard clarity and a high‑energy, well‑sequenced performance yields an almost perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Super crispy, cleanest recording on the Archive; virtually no distortion, especially clear bass lines and overall balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Praised as a great, flowing sequence of tunes that maintains momentum throughout, hitting a performance peak in the second set.

band_member_comments.Phil: Thundering bass lines noted for their clarity and power.
